text: In McTaggart's framework, the A-series orders events by which set of temporal characterizations?
choices: A bare, directionless sequence with no earlier/later direction
Fixed tenseless dates assigned by clock and calendar
explanation: The A-series orders events by the monadic properties past, present, and future -- properties that change as time passes, so that one and the same event is first future, then present, then past. Option 0 names the B-series relations, which are permanent and tenseless; option 2 describes the C-series, a bare directionless ordering; option 3 describes fixed tenseless dates, again a B-series notion. Only the A-series uses the changing properties past/present/future.
